en: The transient “Thinking” indicator appears during an active turn when no reply, tool activity or confirmation is being shown. It disappears when the turn stops or ends; it does not require reasoning text from the CLI. No permanent ended-status label remains below the conversation.
zh: “正在思考”是临时提示：本轮运行中，未在显示回复、工具活动或等待确认时出现；停止或结束后隐藏，不要求 CLI 先传回思考文本。会话底部不再常驻“本轮已结束”等状态文字。
